rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Nmap MCP Server exposes the popular Nmap network scanning tool through MCP, providing comprehensive network discovery and security assessment capabilities to AI assistants. Built with FastMCP and Python's subprocess module, it offers 11 specialized tools covering basic scans, service detection, OS fingerprinting, vulnerability scanning, stealth reconnaissance, and custom command execution with configurable timeouts and output formats. Designed for network administrators, security professionals, and penetration testers who want to integrate network scanning workflows into their AI-assisted security analysis and infrastructure management tasks.
